messages:
lisa: Heads-up: noticed a handful of users still have project-admin role after last night's RBAC refactor. Looks like SCIM deprov didn't remove them. Threading logs.

mohit: which users? any pattern?

lisa: @mohit attaching example: extId 12345 - SCIM sent delete for group `project-admins`, but audit shows KMS decrypt request for audit-log-key at 02:14 from that user. :confused: 
`SCIM payload: {
  "operation": "delete",
  "group": "project-admins",
  "members": [{"value": "user-12345"}]
}`

sec_bot: Alert: Deprovision failures 3 -> 6 in window 02:12-02:20. Reconcile job retried but returned 200 for SCIM and user still in group mapping.

eva: I saw this too — suspect is attribute normalization we applied (lowercasing extId) during pipeline. If extId stored as `User-12345` and SCIM used `user-12345` mismatch => deprovision didn't match mapping.

tony: If SCIM delete didn't match, provisioning service might have left role binding. Need to check group->IAM reconciliation code and tombstone pruning.

lisa: Log snippet: `2026-03-18T02:14:23Z reconcile: scim.delete member=user-12345 result=200 mapping_resolved=false`

jen: Can someone grep for `mapping_resolved=false` and list affected tenants? I'll kick off emergency reconcile.

mohit: Also audit logs show these users accessed kms key `kms-prod-audit` at 02:16 — likely service principals. If we revoke role bindings, will we break runtime? Let's scope to interactive users first.

eva: Agree — staging confirm: run reconcile for human users only. I can run a dry-run reconcile and post diff.

lisa: Action items: (1) run dry-run reconcile for affected tenants (eva). (2) add normalization alias mapping in SCIM matcher for legacy extId formats (devsec). (3) backfill removed role bindings where safe (jen). (4) add audit alert if scim.delete returns 200 but mapping_resolved=false (mohit).

mohit: I'll add an alert and a quick fix: if delete returns 200 but mapping_resolved=false, mark as suspect and schedule immediate re-eval on next reconcile.

jen: Dry run results: would remove 4 human accounts, 2 service accounts flagged - holding those. Preparing PR to map legacy extIds.

deploy-bot: deploy 2109877001: reconcile-fix -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

lisa: Thanks. Postmortem if anything goes wrong. Also need to check KMS key policy logs to ensure no lingering principals. tagging @security-oncall.

sec_oncall: Oncall here — monitoring KMS usage and will revoke if suspicious. Keep me updated.

lisa: :thumbsup: closing loop once reconcile final run completes. I'll update ticket #SEC-4321.
